source: Owner's direct Oct 17 message, Netlify credit screenshot, and ChatGPT Notifications screenshot

decisions.approval: Owner will monitor Netlify balances and proactively advise if credits are low. Do not repeatedly ask for credit screenshots or require a live billing connector for every subsequent release. Owner-provided Oct 17 screenshot records 940 of 1000 Personal credits; 28.8 of 30 operational credits, which cannot pay for deployments; auto recharge off. Personal credits expire Nov 14, operational Nov 11, 2026.
decisions.scope: Supersedes ONLY the prior assistant-managed per-release billing screenshot/maximum-seven-day credit refresh requirement during the known current Personal grant. Keep the known 15-credit minimum, no purchases/automatic top-ups, fail closed on known insufficient/tampered credit data or expired known grant, and secure provider state. Owner may change monitoring approach later. Do not infer a perpetual known balance from the dated screenshot.
decisions.release_guard: Allow owner-monitored known grant through its expiration without nagging for a new screenshot; never on a mere ordinary docs/source push, and never without current separately explicit owner publication permission and the existing deliberate tagged release process.

decisions.approval: DO NOT publish unless owner explicitly approves that release. Ask before initiating any production publishing, Supabase Edge function deployment or coordinated production data rollout. Past consent to use credits, past release approval or a verified balance does not approve a later release.
decisions.preserve: All pre-release tests, version/source verification, beta access, SSO distinction, authenticated/private data, recovery pin, release marker and nonproduction deployment holds. Docs/source/CI commits must use skip-Netlify/no-publish discipline.

decisions.topic: Daily backup-health watch without repeating full restore
decisions.approval: Keep daily DIC Backup Watchdog (11 a.m. America/Denver) and disable redundant six-hour Dial In Backup Health. Do not repeatedly test or reconstruct the hosted system: full encrypted provider restore has already passed. Automated daily detection of a missing/stale GitHub backup, Drive copy, or integrity evidence is cheap and useful; deeper restore exercises are periodic/risk-based, for example quarterly or after material recovery changes, not daily. Preserve all existing encrypted archives and separate Apps Script delivery/failure alerting.

decisions.observation: User screenshot shows ChatGPT Settings → Notifications → Tasks = Push, Email, unchanged throughout prior questioning. Some scheduler metadata returned notifications_enabled=false/email_enabled=false for each task; these booleans do not establish that account-level Tasks notifications are off or that an alert failed. Do not ask the owner to re-enable these settings repeatedly; actual failure notification delivery was not tested by this UI screenshot.

unapproved_actions: NO Netlify publication, SQL data mutation, Edge deployment, plan purchase, automatic credit recharge, or backup archive deletion is authorized by this documentation/guard alignment.
